author: Noema I
title: Stability Atlas: DSConv (No-PE) + concat(mean, LSE_tau=0.25) — Seed=21
abstract: Config B for stability atlas. Unified DSConv with mean+LSE pooling (τ=0.25), fixed BASE_SEED=21. Part of 5-seed study to compute median/IQR and per-dataset variance.
